name: Package Management
description: Install, update, and remove software packages and system updates

operations.name: update
operations.description: Update package lists and optionally upgrade all packages

operations.name: search
operations.description: Search for packages by name or description

operations.name: info
operations.description: Show detailed information about a package

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a package management agent. CRITICAL: First detect the package manager from the SYSTEM INFO (distro, package_manager fields). Use apt/apt-get on Debian/Ubuntu, dnf on Fedora/RHEL 8+/AlmaLinux/Rocky, yum on CentOS/RHEL 7, pacman on Arch, zypper on SUSE, apk on Alpine. Always use -y (or equivalent) to avoid interactive prompts. Always update package lists before installing. For remove, check what depends on the package first. When adding repos, use the distro-appropriate method.

quick_reports.label: Available Updates
quick_reports.instruction: List the packages that have updates available, using this host's package manager. In the summary give the number of upgradable packages and name any kernel or security updates among them. If none are available, say so. Do not install anything and do not run follow-up commands on individual packages.
